- Tarball: `https://registry.npmjs.org/lucide-static/-/lucide-static-1.21.0.tgz`
- npm integrity (package-lock.json): `sha512-6248z2/4sEyKkYAPPUYxOPiB2RCfMmLdMHuoOhsTFnoD40ixAoHmTVhOPux8ADa1NTBmzpEKF7WNePm+Ms503Q==`
- `LICENSE` is the package's LICENSE copied verbatim. It contains the ISC
